ledger: Space 1 (Exterior): Desert highway and shoulder where a vintage wood-paneled station wagon is parked.

Space 2 (Car Interior): Station wagon cabin visible through the front windshield and driver-side windows, containing tan seats and a rearview mirror, with the desert background visible through the far passenger-side windows.
Boundary/Openings: Intact front windshield with wiper blades separating the cabin interior from the solid metal hood/cowl; driver-side windows along the side of the cabin.
Subject placement (00:00-00:09): Woman leaning with crossed arms on the driver-side hood directly in front of the windshield.

findings.entity: Woman and station wagon hood/windshield junction
findings.invariant_violated: Impossible spatial connectivity / body occupying solid structure
findings.description: The woman is positioned as though leaning out of an opening with her arms resting on the hood, but her torso emerges directly out of the solid metal hood/cowl in front of the intact windshield glass where no opening or cabin space exists for her lower body.
